scripts.build: pnpm generate-contract && pnpm generate-routes && vite build --config vite.config.ts && tsc -b
scripts.dev: pnpm generate-contract && pnpm generate-routes && vite --config vite.config.ts --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.generate-contract: ../.venv/bin/python prototype/catalogue-overview/generate_contract.py && json2ts -i src/generated/catalogue-dataset.schema.json -o src/generated/catalogue-dataset.generated.ts --bannerComment '/* PROTOTYPE — generated from the accepted Pydantic CatalogueDataset schema. Do not edit. */'
scripts.test:e2e: cd .. && .venv/bin/python -m car_picker build-site --dataset tests/fixtures/one-offer-catalogue-dataset.json --output var/site && cd frontend && playwright test
